answer_2.quote: We have used the following metrics for evaluating our model and the baseline. σ_p : phoneme-level standard deviation of duration or pitch in a speech. ... Determinant: a determinant of the similarity matrix is used to evaluate the diversity among prosodic features of 10 generated samples.

answer_4.quote: Via Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT), we assign ten testers ... to a pair of audio samples ... ask them to choose among three options: A: sample A has more varied prosody than sample B, Same, B: the opposite. ... Ten testers are assigned to each audio sample ... give a score between 1 to 5 on a 9-scale based on the sample's naturalness, focusing on the prosody aspect.
answer_4.guideline: Testers were asked to judge which sample has more varied prosody (or if they are equally varied) and to rate naturalness of prosody on a Likert scale.
